title: Calgary SPV-001 Zero Lot Line, Revision 5 (with Revision 4 history)
code_edition: NBC–Alberta Edition; edition year unstated in Revision 5

facts.text: SPV-001 is dated October 1, 2017 and identifies Revision 5 as March 5, 2026; Calgary says Revision 5 was accepted by CSTIC on March 5, 2026.
The document names National Building Code – Alberta Edition, Division B, Article 9.10.15.5 and reproduces Sentences (8) and (9) on roof soffit projection; it does not print an edition year.

Its stated design context is single-family homes up to three storeys with 1.5 m on the easement side and a zero side at or crossing the property line; the text says the SPV cannot be altered or deviated from and a changed scope requires a site-specific variance or prescriptive path.

The current Revision 5 contains projection wording on two pages: page 4 states maximum soffit and footing projection into the easement of 0.3 m each; page 5 says the MARW agreement can allow 0.3 m eave and 0.6 m footing projection across the property line. The measurement basis and relationship between these statements are not reconciled in the text.

The permit condition applies the SPV to the building-permit address and requires a MARW agreement satisfactory to Calgary on the parcel and adjacent parcel over a 1.5 m width parallel to the property line; p.5 states the buildings including eaves must remain at least 0.9 m apart.

The 2023 Calgary guide says a formal variance request is submitted with the Request for Specific Variance form and supporting documentation; the form includes permit number, code/standard, details, reason, supporting documentation, property address/legal description, and owner/agent declaration/signature fields.
facts.locator: 2023 Calgary Guide, PDF pp.2–4; Request for Specific Variance form, PDF p.1

facts.text: The attached Revision 4 is dated June 17, 2024 and is the prior published version of this same SPV number, not an individual permit decision.

limitations: This is a standing posted municipal variance, not an individual applicant's package or original applicant message.
Revision 5 does not name the NBC(AE) edition year.
The Calgary page says posted variances are subject to removal; direct posting and continued applicability are time-sensitive.

SPV-001 Revision 5 has different projection wording on pp.4–5 (0.3 m into the easement versus 0.6 m across the property line for footing projection); the measurement bases are unclear and were not reconciled.
